edges = [(0, 1), (0, 8), (0, 7), (0, 3), (1, 8), (1, 9), (1, 6), (2, 8), (2, 7), (2, 9), (2, 6), (3, 8), (3, 5), (3, 4), (4, 6), (4, 5), (4, 7), (5, 8), (5, 9), (6, 7), (8, 9)]

print(f"Number of vertices: {G.number_of_nodes()}")
